action.description: 'validate_input' returns the full context pack and 'digest' the same run as three readable lines per node - both deterministic and free. 'generate_detections' drafts one detection per node and costs a heavy-tier call per batch. 'normalize_paths' (stage N4, the pack's own schema) is planned and is rejected with a message naming it.

max_nodes_per_call.description: Content-budget guard for generate_detections: how many steps go in one call. Batching is by path, and the whole path's outline travels with every batch, so a split never costs predecessor context.

artifact_ids.description: Registered artifact ids for adversary_path_projector exports: one path graph, one scenario seed, or both documents of the same projection run. The usual route, and the only one that works when the export lives in cloud storage.

artifact_id.description: A single registered artifact id. Accepted because the shell speaks the singular; a pair needs artifact_ids.

sources.description: File paths to projector exports, as an alternative to artifact_ids. Local paths only.

file_path.description: Injected by the shell when a singular artifact_id is resolved; treated as a source path.

path.description: Injected by the shell alongside file_path; treated as a source path.

accept_unverified_pair.description: Join two documents that carry no provenance block, on equal derived projection identity. The join is recorded as asserted_by_operator and never as verified.

flow_map_artifact_id.description: Registered artifact id of a JSON flow map. Its lineage against the export's flow_map_sha256 is recorded as same_map, edited_map or unhashed and is never grounds for refusal: an analyst's edited copy is an expected input.

flow_map_path.description: Local path to a JSON flow map, as an alternative to flow_map_artifact_id.
